subject.title: [Bug]: Assistant text preceding a tool call in the same turn is silently dropped on Signal channel (Anthropic/Sonnet, non-streaming)

question: Should this Signal same-turn text/tool-call delivery report be routed to the OpenClaw runtime/channel code path, with this ClawHub issue kept only as a tracking pointer or duplicate?
rationale: The user impact is serious, but current ClawHub main does not contain the Signal delivery code, and ClawSweeper's ClawHub cleanup policy only supports closing issues that are definitely implemented on main.

options.title: Route To OpenClaw Runtime
options.body: Treat the report as a runtime/channel delivery bug and consolidate discussion with the preferred canonical thread before assigning implementation.

options.title: Keep As ClawHub API Gap
options.body: Keep it in ClawHub only if maintainers identify a missing package/plugin/channel API that prevents external Signal handling from reporting delivery state.

options.title: Consolidate With Duplicate Only
options.body: Pick either this issue or https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2991 as the canonical report and link the other manually.

recommendation.title: Route To OpenClaw Runtime
recommendation.body: Treat the report as a runtime/channel delivery bug and consolidate discussion with the preferred canonical thread before assigning implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties them to the current repository scope and OpenClaw/ClawHub boundary text used for this routing decision.
